title: The Promise of Eternal Life
definition: The Promise of Eternal Life is God's gift of everlasting life to all who believe in Jesus Christ.
summary: Eternal life is received in Christ and continues forever with God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the resurrection and the life, giving eternal life to His sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Promise of Eternal Life helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is eternal life is received in christ and continues forever with god.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. The Promise of Eternal Life reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let the promise of eternal life shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
